backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles, time zones, habit storage, permissions, and local-day logic with quote retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to involved frontend files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files including components, state logic, API hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme definitions using OKLCH variables for light/dark modes and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app providing query client, header with auth controls, quote banner, BecomingView, footer, and toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert component prompting unauthenticated users to sign in with Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing whether the user is signed in, based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button handling login/logout via Internet Identity with state-aware text and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/quotes/DailyMoti: Component showing daily quote with loading skeleton, timezone prompt, error fallback, and rendered quote text.
frontend/src/components/quotes/TimeZoneI: Renders a prompt for selecting and saving a user time zone using backend actor calls with validation and loading state.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: Defines React Query hooks for loading and mutating habits, handling actor availability, authentication, errors, and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habits view managing auth state, loading, errors, and rendering charts, summaries, and the habit grid by month.
Displays a styled error alert with a user-friendly message and optional retry button.
Provides a skeleton UI mimicking the habit grid layout for loading states.
Modal for editing habit name, unit type, and monthly volume with validation and mutation calls.
Displays the habits matrix for a selected month with day columns and habit rows.
Defines layout constants and helpers for aligning habit info and day columns in the grid.
Allows users to add new habits with inline input, managing local state and mutation calls.
Renders a row for a habit with daily checkboxes, volume info, and an actions popover, handling completion toggles and edit modal state.
Provides a popover around a habit row that allows triggering edit actions from a small menu.
Aggregates and displays monthly total reps and time across habits, showing only if volume-tracking habits exist.
Displays month selection tabs for 2026 and notifies when the selected month changes.
Generates a Recharts bar chart summarizing yearly reps and time totals per month for all volume-tracking habits.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Exports static 2026 month metadata and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Contains habit completion/volume utilities, building completion maps, computing totals, and formatting volume display strings.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Utility functions for validating, parsing, normalizing, and formatting time strings for habit volume tracking.
frontend/src/features/quotes/hooks/useDa: Fetches the user's timezone and daily quote using React Query, parsing quote strings and handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates a backend actor tied to the Internet Identity, initializes access control, and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Similar to useActor but adds timeout handling, error normalization, and manual retry support for actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login/logout helpers, and a React context for managing stored identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color variables, light theme settings, and glass/UX utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts React, sets up React Query, and wraps the app with the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Utility functions to normalize errors and detect/format stopped-canister replica rejection errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, architectural notes, existing features, and a pending request related to adding a yearly progress bar chart. Includes schema versioning, project state tracking, and feature requirement details.
